about.title: Shafter Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Shafter's roads carry a steady mix of farm equipment, commuters, and highway traffic, and that combination shows up in the crash data. In the most recent year on record, the city logged 44 injury collisions with 72 people hurt and 2 lives lost. Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. see a noticeable rise in reported crashes, likely tied to end-of-week travel along corridors like Santa Fe Way and E Lerdo Highway. If you were injured in one of these collisions, the aftermath can be overwhelming — medical visits, missed work, and calls from an insurance adjuster all at once. LawProactive doesn't practice law or charge you anything; we simply connect you with an independent personal injury attorney in the network who can look at what happened and explain your options. That conversation costs nothing, and there's no obligation to move forward. Getting informed early, before evidence disappears or memories fade, often matters more than people realize.
commonInjuries: Torn ligaments and soft tissue damage

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Ticking
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash to file a claim, but that window shrinks dramatically — sometimes to six months — if a government entity like a road authority is involved. An attorney can spot that issue early, before it costs you your claim.

items.title: Fault Isn't All-or-Nothing
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly at fault, just reduced by your share. An insurer may try to shift blame onto you to lower a payout, and having someone review the facts protects your position.

items.title: Don't Give a Recorded Statement Alone
items.desc: The other driver's insurer may ask for a recorded statement soon after the crash — this is rarely in your favor. Speaking with an independent attorney first, and preserving evidence like photos and witness info, helps protect a claim before details get lost or twisted.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and attorneys in the network typically work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost to have your situation reviewed.

items.question: I was in a crash near 7th Standard Road — what should I do first?
items.answer: Get medical attention if you haven't already, and try to document the scene with photos if it's safe to do so. Avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer before speaking with an attorney, since early statements can be used to minimize your claim. Preserving evidence quickly matters, especially on busy corridors where conditions can change fast.

items.question: What if the crash happened on a county or state road?
items.answer: Claims involving government-maintained roads can carry a much shorter deadline, sometimes as little as six months, instead of the standard two-year statute of limitations. This is one of the biggest reasons to get informed quickly rather than wait. An independent attorney can help determine which deadline applies to your situation.
